meta.description: B2B demand generation that creates demand as well as captures it. Programme-led, cross-channel and measured against commercial outcomes.

h1: Create demand. Capture demand. Learn from both.
hero.sub: Some buyers are already looking. Others need a reason to care before they ever search for you. A useful demand programme handles both, then connects what happens to pipeline and the next commercial decision.

sections.heading: B2B Demand Generation Needs Demand Creation and Demand Capture

items.q: How is demand generation different from lead generation?
items.a: Demand generation is broader than lead generation. It includes work that creates awareness, understanding and preference before a buyer is ready to identify themselves, as well as work that captures existing intent. Lead generation focuses more specifically on creating identifiable prospects or enquiries for follow-up. A useful growth system connects the two.

items.q: How long before demand generation produces measurable pipeline?
items.a: There is no universal demand generation timeline. Existing demand, deal cycle, audience size, programme type and starting brand position all affect how quickly commercial signals appear. Capture activity can sometimes show movement sooner than demand creation. We define leading and downstream measures at the start rather than promise a fixed pipeline date.

items.q: What channels does B2B demand generation actually use?
items.a: B2B demand generation can use content, SEO, paid search, paid social, events, ABM, community, partnerships, email and direct sales activity. The channel list is not the strategy. We choose channels based on the ICP, buying behaviour, message and whether the immediate job is creating demand, capturing it or both.

items.q: What does a demand generation consultant do?
items.a: A demand generation consultant helps decide who to target, what the market needs to hear, which programmes can create or capture demand, how activity connects to Sales and how performance should be measured. At Commview that can include hands-on execution as well as strategy rather than stopping at a campaign plan.

items.q: Do you run the demand generation programmes as well as plan them?
items.a: Yes, where that is the right engagement. Commview can write emails, shape content, review SEO and paid activity, analyse conversion and coordinate specialist execution. The aim is to keep strategy close enough to delivery that we can see whether the commercial hypothesis is actually working and change it when needed.
